personal.title: LinkedIn Poster
personal.description: For anyone who cringes at LinkedIn or never gets round to posting: drop your photos, say what happened in your own words, and an LLM turns it into a clean post you can publish without ever opening the feed. Prefer to write it yourself? The LLM is optional.
